assets.name: SM_Tree_Oak_A
assets.notes: Classic broad oak: short stout bole, five spreading limbs, lumpy rounded crown.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Oak_B
assets.notes: Tall upright oak with a central leader and an oval crown.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Oak_C
assets.notes: Low, wide, gnarled field oak; near-horizontal limbs under a flat-bottomed crown.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Birch_A
assets.notes: Single slender white-barked birch, airy narrow crown of drooping twigs.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Birch_B
assets.notes: Three-stem birch clump leaning apart.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Pine_A
assets.notes: Dense spruce cone with boughs almost to the ground (folded needle strips).

assets.name: SM_Tree_Pine_B
assets.notes: Scots-pine type: tall bare orange trunk, flat cloud-pruned needle pads.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Pine_C
assets.notes: Tall slender fir for mountain slopes.

assets.name: SM_Tree_PineSnow_A
assets.notes: Snow-laden spruce: MT_NeedlesSnow boughs with solid MT_Snow pillows on every tier.

assets.name: SM_Tree_PineSnow_B
assets.notes: Taller snow-laden fir, same construction.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Dead_A
assets.notes: Dead, gnarled oak with broken limbs and fine twig tips (no leaves).

assets.name: SM_Tree_Dead_B
assets.notes: Tall dead snag with a broken top and a few spiky limbs.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Giant_A
assets.notes: Great Forest giant: ~4 m buttressed trunk, surface roots, canopy of cloud masses.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Giant_B
assets.notes: Tallest Great Forest giant: ~5 m trunk, two rings of canopy masses.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Demon_A
assets.notes: Twisted rope-bark demon tree with a wide claw crown and sparse purple foliage.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Demon_B
assets.notes: Corkscrew-trunk demon tree with drooping claw branches.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Demon_C
assets.notes: Squat split-trunk demon tree, spiky.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Palm_A
assets.notes: Oasis palm: ringed, gently curved trunk, arching fronds, dry frond skirt (MT_GrassDry).

assets.name: SM_Tree_Palm_B
assets.notes: Twin-trunk oasis palm.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Jungle_A
assets.notes: Southern jungle emergent with a broad flat umbrella canopy and buttress flare.

assets.name: SM_Tree_Jungle_B
assets.notes: Taller leaning jungle tree with a layered two-tier canopy.

assets.name: SM_Bush_A
assets.notes: Round leafy bush.

assets.name: SM_Bush_B
assets.notes: Low, wide spreading bush (lighter birch-green leaves).

assets.name: SM_Bush_C
assets.notes: Flowering bush: leaf clumps sprinkled with MT_Flowers cards.

assets.name: SM_Bush_D
assets.notes: Tall upright shrub (hedgerow filler).

assets.name: SM_Bush_Snow_A
assets.notes: Evergreen shrub under snow: MT_NeedlesSnow clumps with MT_Snow lumps on top.

assets.name: SM_Bush_Desert_A
assets.notes: Round dry desert scrub: twiggy MT_BarkDead stems with dry tufts.

assets.name: SM_Bush_Desert_B
assets.notes: Wider creosote-like dry scrub.

assets.name: SM_Plant_DemonGiant_A
assets.notes: Alien tentacle-frond rosette with a fiddlehead stalk on a swollen bulb.

assets.name: SM_Plant_DemonGiant_B
assets.notes: Lantern stalks: curled stalks ending in drooping purple tassels.

assets.name: SM_Plant_DemonGiant_C
assets.notes: Spiky purple rosette with a tall flowering spike.

assets.name: SM_Mushroom_Giant_A
assets.notes: Single 5.6 m mushroom: flared stem, ring skirt, cap with gill underside.

assets.name: SM_Mushroom_Giant_B
assets.notes: Cluster of four giant mushrooms (1.5-3.9 m).

assets.name: SM_Fern_A
assets.notes: Fern clump, arched fronds.

assets.name: SM_Fern_B
assets.notes: Large Great Forest fern.

assets.name: SM_Grass_A
assets.notes: Meadow grass clump (crossed + fanned blade cards).

assets.name: SM_Grass_B
assets.notes: Tall grass clump.

assets.name: SM_Grass_C
assets.notes: Low, wide lawn patch.

assets.name: SM_Grass_Dry_A
assets.notes: Dry grass tuft.

assets.name: SM_Grass_Dry_B
assets.notes: Tall dry steppe grass.

assets.name: SM_Grass_Snow_A
assets.notes: Frosted dry grass poking out of a low MT_Snow mound.

assets.name: SM_Wheat_A
assets.notes: Dense 2 x 2 m wheat patch, ~1 m tall (tiles edge to edge).

assets.name: SM_Wheat_B
assets.notes: Wind-bent 2 x 2 m wheat patch.

assets.name: SM_Flowers_A
assets.notes: Low wildflower clump with grass.

assets.name: SM_Flowers_B
assets.notes: Tall wildflowers.

assets.name: SM_Flowers_C
assets.notes: Wide meadow flower patch (three sub-clumps).

assets.name: SM_Reeds_A
assets.notes: Reed clump for river banks.

assets.name: SM_Reeds_B
assets.notes: Dense tall cattail bed.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Small_A
assets.notes: Small chiselled rock.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Small_B
assets.notes: Small angular rock.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Small_C
assets.notes: Cluster of three stones (path / stream scatter).

assets.name: SM_Rock_Medium_A
assets.notes: Medium boulder.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Medium_B
assets.notes: Medium upright boulder.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Medium_C
assets.notes: Medium flat boulder with a mossy top (MT_RockMossy).

assets.name: SM_Rock_Large_A
assets.notes: Large boulder with chiselled facets.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Large_B
assets.notes: Large low outcrop with a mossy top.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Cliff_A
assets.notes: 14 m cliff chunk: blocky massif, vertical fractures, subtle strata.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Cliff_B
assets.notes: 24 m tall fractured cliff chunk (mountain faces, canyon walls).

assets.name: SM_Rock_Cliff_C
assets.notes: 28 m massive wide cliff chunk.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Snow_A
assets.notes: Boulder (MT_RockSnow) with a separate MT_Snow cap sheet.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Snow_B
assets.notes: Large layered rock with snow on the top and ledges.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Desert_A
assets.notes: Layered sandstone boulder.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Desert_B
assets.notes: Flat-topped sandstone mesa outcrop.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Desert_C
assets.notes: Sandstone slab with tilted strata.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Arch_A
assets.notes: ~19 m natural sandstone arch on two footings.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Pillar_A
assets.notes: ~19 m sandstone hoodoo: flared base, thin neck, cap rock.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Pillar_B
assets.notes: ~37 m weathered granite spire with buttresses and cracks.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Demon_A
assets.notes: Cluster of tall obsidian shards on a dark core (flat-shaded, razor edges).

assets.name: SM_Rock_Demon_B
assets.notes: Jagged 12 m obsidian crag.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Demon_C
assets.notes: Low jagged obsidian outcrop.

assets.name: SM_Rock_Pale_A
assets.notes: Wind-rounded pale boulder (Heaven plateau).

assets.name: SM_Rock_Pale_B
assets.notes: Tall chiselled pale slab.

assets.name: SM_Log_A
assets.notes: Fallen oak log, sunk into the ground, splintered ends (MT_BarkDead) and branch stubs.

assets.name: SM_Stump_A
assets.notes: Broken stump with root flare and surface roots.

assets.name: SM_Asura_House_S_A
assets.notes: Small two-storey half-timbered house, eaves to the street.

assets.name: SM_Asura_House_S_B
assets.notes: Small gable-fronted house: stone ground floor, jettied timber upper floor, loft door with hoist beam.

assets.name: SM_Asura_House_M_A
assets.notes: Medium house, eaves to the street: stone ground floor, jettied timber upper floor, two dormers.

assets.name: SM_Asura_House_M_B
assets.notes: Medium gable-fronted town house, three storeys with two stacked jetties.

assets.name: SM_Asura_House_L_A
assets.notes: Large three-storey town house, eaves to the street, three dormers, two chimneys.

assets.name: SM_Asura_House_L_B
assets.notes: Large hip-roofed corner house with an octagonal oriel turret on the front-left corner.

assets.name: SM_Asura_Shop_A
assets.notes: Shop: two ground-floor counters under red and blue cloth awnings, hanging sign, timber upper floor.

assets.name: SM_Asura_Inn_A
assets.notes: Three-storey inn: stone ground floor with a carriage arch, balcony, hanging sign, dormers.

assets.name: SM_Asura_Tower_A
assets.notes: Stone watch / bell tower with a jettied half-timbered belfry and a steep pyramid roof.

assets.name: SM_Asura_Manor_A
assets.notes: Boreas-style noble manor (Roa): three-storey main block, two forward wings and a courtyard wall with a gate; the courtyard opens toward -Y.

assets.name: SM_Asura_Keep_A
assets.notes: Castle keep for Roa: square stone keep with a battered base, crenellated walk, four corner turrets with red conical roofs and a hipped central roof.

assets.name: SM_Noble_House_A
assets.notes: Noble town mansion: raised ground floor, pedimented piano nobile with balconettes, blue mansard roof with dormers and a gold crest, columned door portico with steps.

assets.name: SM_Noble_House_B
assets.notes: Noble corner house: arched ground floor, balconettes, steep blue hip roof with a gold crest and a round corner turret with a conical spire.

assets.name: SM_Noble_House_C
assets.notes: Symmetrical two-storey noble residence with a projecting central frontispiece crowned by a pediment, a balcony on columns over the door, hip roof with gold crest.

assets.name: SM_Noble_Hall_A
assets.notes: Government hall: stone podium with a grand stair, hexastyle portico with a pediment, two tall storeys of arched windows, low blue hip roof behind a balustrade and a central dome on a windowed drum with a gold lantern.

assets.name: SM_Noble_Tower_A
assets.notes: Slender white clock tower: pilastered shaft with string courses, four gilded clock faces, an open arcaded belfry and an octagonal blue spire with a gold finial.

assets.name: SM_Rural_House_A
assets.notes: Thatched plank cottage with an exterior stone chimney.

assets.name: SM_Rural_House_B
assets.notes: One-and-a-half storey farmhouse: plank walls, red tile roof with two dormers, front porch.

assets.name: SM_Rural_House_C
assets.notes: Long thatched farmhouse with a hipped roof, a lean-to woodshed on its right end and a chimney.

assets.name: SM_Rural_Barn_A
assets.notes: Thatched gable-fronted barn with big double doors (3.6 m wide x 3.8 m) facing -Y and a hayloft hatch.

assets.name: SM_Rural_Barn_B
assets.notes: Red-roofed barn: stone lower storey, plank loft storey, two cart doors on the long -Y side, hoist beam in the gable.

assets.name: SM_Rural_Windmill_Body
assets.notes: Tower windmill body: tapered whitewashed octagonal tower on a stone base with a thatched conical cap and the windshaft; origin on the tower axis at ground level. Attach SM_Rural_Windmill_Blades at the 'hub' anchor (0, -3.15, 11.25): the blades rotate about the Y axis (their forward axis, facing -Y).

assets.name: SM_Rural_Windmill_Blades
assets.notes: Four windmill sails (7.4 m radius) with the hub centre at the origin; the sails lie in the XZ plane and rotate about the Y axis. Place at SM_Rural_Windmill_Body's 'hub' anchor (0, -3.15, 11.25).

assets.name: SM_Rural_Well
assets.notes: Village well: stone ring with coping, water surface (MT_Glass) inside, timber posts, winch with crank, rope and bucket under a small shingled roof.

assets.name: SM_Rural_Fence_2m
assets.notes: Post-and-rail fence segment spanning x = -1..+1 m. Chain segments end to end every 2 m: the smaller +X post nests inside the next segment's -X post, so joints never z-fight.

assets.name: SM_Rural_Fence_4m
assets.notes: Post-and-rail fence segment spanning x = -2..+2 m with a middle post; chains like the 2 m segment.

assets.name: SM_Rural_Haystack
assets.notes: Beehive haystack (MT_RoofThatch straw), ~2.9 m across, with a drying pole.

assets.name: SM_Rural_Cart
assets.notes: Two-wheeled farm cart, shafts pointing -Y, resting on a prop leg.

assets.name: SM_Rural_Shed_A
assets.notes: Small lean-to plank shed with a boarded mono-pitch roof and a woodpile on its right side.

assets.name: SM_Rural_GreyratHouse
assets.notes: The Greyrat family house (Buena): two storeys, stone ground floor, plastered upper floor with a timber band, red roof with dormers, front porch, exterior stone chimney and a lean-to kitchen annex behind.

assets.name: SM_North_House_A
assets.notes: Northern house: stone ground floor, timber upper floor, steep slate roof with a snow blanket.

assets.name: SM_North_House_B
assets.notes: Gable-fronted northern house with a steep 60 degree roof, exterior chimney and a covered entry.

assets.name: SM_North_House_C
assets.notes: Stone cottage, one and a half storeys, two snow-capped dormers and gable-end chimneys.

assets.name: SM_North_Shop_A
assets.notes: Magic shop: wide shop window, door flanked by two glowing crystal lanterns (MT_Crystal), hanging sign, snow-capped gable roof with a dormer.

assets.name: SM_North_Guild_A
assets.notes: Adventurer guild: three storeys (stone, then timber), hipped snow roof with dormers, square corner tower with a spire, arched double doors, balcony and a shield-and-swords emblem over the entrance.

assets.name: SM_North_Workshop_A
assets.notes: Smithy / workshop: long stone building with a wide open work front, massive forge chimney and a snowy lean-to shelter with an anvil and a woodpile.

assets.name: SM_North_Tower_A
assets.notes: Round stone watch tower (12-sided, radius 3.2 m) with arched windows, a corbelled parapet band and a steep conical slate roof with a snow cap.

assets.name: SM_Millis_House_A
assets.notes: Gable-fronted Millis town house with an arcaded ground-floor loggia, arched windows and a round oculus in the steep blue gable.

assets.name: SM_Millis_House_B
assets.notes: Millis house with a full-height round corner turret and a tall slender spire, arched windows and blue gable roof with dormers.

assets.name: SM_Millis_House_C
assets.notes: Tall narrow gable-fronted Millis house, four storeys, with a two-storey oriel bay on the front and a round oculus in the gable.

assets.name: SM_Millis_Shop_A
assets.notes: Arcaded Millis shop: three open arches over a loggia with two shop counters under blue awnings, arched windows above, blue roof.

assets.name: SM_Millis_Tower_A
assets.notes: Round white Millis tower (radius 3.2 m) with arched windows, a corbelled gallery and a tall slender blue spire with an iron finial.

assets.name: SM_Millis_Chapel_A
assets.notes: Millis chapel: buttressed nave with pointed windows, a rose window over the pointed-arch door on the west (-Y) front, a square bell tower with a spire on the front-left corner and an apse at the back.

assets.name: SM_VFX_Ring
assets.notes: Thin torus, major radius 1.0 m, tube radius 0.035 m, lying in the XY plane, centred on the origin. UV: u = 0..1 around the ring, v = 0..1 around the tube.

assets.name: SM_VFX_ShockRing
assets.notes: Flat annulus in the XY plane: inner radius 0.8 m, outer 1.0 m, 6 mm thick, centred on the origin. UV: u = 0..1 around, v = 0 at the inner edge to 1 at the outer edge (top and bottom faces).

assets.name: SM_VFX_Disc
assets.notes: Flat disc of radius 1.0 m in the XY plane, 4 mm thick, centred on the origin. Planar UV 0..1 (u = 0.5 + x/2, v = 0.5 + y/2) on both faces.

assets.name: SM_VFX_Crescent
assets.notes: Air-blade crescent lying flat in the XY plane: 2.0 m chord along Y, curving toward +X, 0.27 m wide at the middle, lens-shaped 5 cm thick section with sharp edges; bounding-box centre on the origin. UV: u = 0..1 along the arc (tip at -Y to tip at +Y), v = 0 inner (concave) edge to 1 outer edge.

assets.name: SM_VFX_Flame
assets.notes: Teardrop flame tongue 1.0 m tall; origin at the base point (z = 0), tip curling toward +X. UV: u = 0..1 around, v = 0 at the base to 1 at the tip.

assets.name: SM_VFX_Funnel
assets.notes: Tornado funnel: open twisted funnel 8.0 m tall, origin at the centre of the bottom ring (radius 1.0 m, z = 0), flaring to radius 3.0 m at the top; at the top, five helical lobes (0.35 turns over the height), axis leaning gently; a 3 cm double wall so both sides render. UV: u = 0..1 around (following the helix), v = 0 at the bottom to 1 at the top, on both the outer and inner surfaces.

assets.name: SM_VFX_Beam
assets.notes: Open cylinder (a 1.5 cm double wall so both sides render), radius 1.0 m, from z = 0 to z = 1.0 m; scale Z for the beam length. UV: u = 0..1 around, v = 0 at the base to 1 at the top.

assets.name: SM_VFX_DragonSegment
assets.notes: Smooth tube body segment for the water dragon: radius 0.5 m, 1.0 m long along Y (y = -0.5..0.5), capped ends, centred on the origin; chain segments 1 m apart along the body curve (the head's neck ring is also 0.5 m). UV: u = 0..1 around, v = 0 at y = -0.5 to 1 at y = +0.5.

assets.name: SM_VFX_DragonHead
assets.notes: Stylised eastern water-dragon head, 3.0 m long, facing +Y (snout at +Y), smooth, with a slightly open jaw, swept-back horns, long whiskers, brow ridges, eyes and fangs; bounding-box centre on the origin. The neck ring (radius ~0.5 m, matching SM_VFX_DragonSegment) is at the 'neck' anchor. UV: u around, v along +Y on the head and jaw; u around / v along each horn and whisker.

assets.name: SM_VFX_Spike_A
assets.notes: Jagged rock spike (earth magic), 3.0 m tall, base radius 0.6 m centred on the origin at z = 0, slot MT_Rock, faceted; box-projected UVs (1 UV = 1 m).

assets.name: SM_VFX_Spike_B
assets.notes: Rock spike cluster: a 3.0 m main spike (base radius 0.55 m centred on the origin at z = 0) with two smaller shards fused at its base; slot MT_Rock, box-projected UVs.

assets.name: SM_VFX_RockChunk_A
assets.notes: Faceted rock chunk ~0.3 m (convex, closed), centred on the origin; slot MT_Rock, box UVs.

assets.name: SM_VFX_RockChunk_B
assets.notes: Faceted rock chunk ~0.4 m, elongated; slot MT_Rock.

assets.name: SM_VFX_RockChunk_C
assets.notes: Faceted rock chunk ~0.5 m, flattened slab; slot MT_Rock.

assets.name: SM_VFX_RockChunk_D
assets.notes: Faceted rock chunk ~0.6 m, blocky; slot MT_Rock.

assets.name: SM_VFX_EarthWall
assets.notes: Earth wall: thick rough stone slab 6.0 m (X) x 1.5 m (Y) x 4.0 m (Z) with a crumbly top edge, base at z = 0, faces -Y; slot MT_Rock, faceted, box-projected UVs.

assets.name: SM_VFX_Crystal
assets.notes: Stone bullet (Stone Cannon): compressed six-sided stone slug 0.5 m long pointing +Z, radius ~0.1 m, faceted; bounding-box centre on the origin; slot MT_Rock, box-projected UVs.

assets.name: SM_VFX_Slug
assets.notes: Stone Cannon drill slug: 0.6 m long along +X (pointed ogive nose at +X), radius 0.15 m, five narrow rifling grooves twisting about a third of a turn from tail to nose, a bevelled flat tail; bounding-box centre on the origin; slot MT_Rock. UV: u = 0..2 around, v = 0..3 from tail to nose.

assets.name: SM_VFX_Spiral
assets.notes: Helix ribbon along +X: 3 turns over 1.0 m at a radius of 0.3 m, the ribbon 0.12 m wide (tapering at both ends) and 1.2 cm thick, lying on the cylinder like a spring band; bounding-box centre on the origin. UV: u = 0..1 across the ribbon, v = 0..3 along it (one unit per turn).

assets.name: SM_VFX_WaveSheet
assets.notes: Wave face: a breaking wall of water 2.0 m wide (Y) and 1.0 m tall whose lip curls forward (+X) over a concave front, a closed body about 0.9 m deep with a sloping back, the crest rolling gently along its width; base at z = 0. UV: u = 0..1 across (Y); v = 0 at the back foot, over the crest and the lip, to 1 at the front foot (the underside continues past 1).

assets.name: SM_VFX_EarthWall_B
assets.notes: Earth wall variant B on the SM_VFX_EarthWall footprint (6.0 m x 1.5 m x 4.0 m, base at z = 0, faces -Y): four leaning stone columns with broken, faceted tops and narrow cracks between them; slot MT_Rock, faceted, box-projected UVs.

assets.name: SM_VFX_EarthWall_C
assets.notes: Earth wall variant C on the SM_VFX_EarthWall footprint (6.0 m x 1.5 m x 4.0 m, base at z = 0, faces -Y): two slabs split by a jagged diagonal fracture, jagged tops, and a chunk broken off the top of the right slab; slot MT_Rock, faceted, box-projected UVs.

assets.name: SM_VFX_Slab
assets.notes: Raised ground slab (Dragon Crush, crater rims): an irregular broken plate of earth about 1.0 m x 1.0 m x 0.25 m with a faceted, slightly domed top and sides tapering to a smaller base; base at z = 0; slot MT_Rock, box-projected UVs.

assets.name: SM_VFX_Glyph
assets.notes: Disturb Magic glyph: a flat dragon-line sigil 1.0 m across in the XY plane, about 1.5 cm thick: a broken outer ring of four arcs with twelve ticks inside it, a thin inner ring, and an angular serpentine dragon line with a chevron head and two whiskers; every line is a thin closed ribbon; centred on the origin. UV: u = distance along each line (m), v = 0..1 across it.

assets.name: SM_VFX_Cone
assets.notes: Pressure cone: an open cone 1.0 m long with its apex at the origin, opening along +Z to a 0.5 m radius mouth; a 1 cm double wall so both sides render. UV: u = 0..1 around, v = 0 at the apex to 1 at the mouth (outer and inner surfaces).

assets.name: SM_Demon_Hut_A
assets.notes: Round rock hut: lumpy dome with a chamfered entrance block, hide door curtain, bone tusks and a crystal.

assets.name: SM_Demon_Hut_B
assets.notes: Twin-dome rock hut with an entrance block and a hide awning on bone poles.

assets.name: SM_Demon_Hut_C
assets.notes: Wide low rock hut with a stone smoke pipe, a hide-covered side opening and a bone drying rack.

assets.name: SM_Demon_House_A
assets.notes: Carved-block demon house: chunky chamfered lower block, stepped upper block under a lumpy dome, recessed windows, hide door and awning, crystal lanterns.

assets.name: SM_Demon_House_B
assets.notes: Tall demon tower-house: tapering chamfered rock block with slit windows, a hide-covered balcony box, a lumpy cap and bone tusks at the top corners.

assets.name: SM_Demon_Stall_A
assets.notes: Demon market stall: carved rock counter, sagging hide canopy on four bone poles, clay pots, crates and a glowing crystal lamp.

assets.name: SM_Demon_Totem_A
assets.notes: Totem of stacked carved demon-rock blocks with glowing crystal eyes, bone horns and a crystal crown (~6 m).

assets.name: SM_Demon_Tower_A
assets.notes: Demon watch tower: tall tapering chamfered rock shaft with slit windows and bone buttresses, a flared lumpy crown and a large glowing crystal spike on top (~20 m).

assets.name: SM_Desert_House_A
assets.notes: Two-storey Rapan house: tan plaster cube, rounded parapet merlons, roof-beam ends, deep windows with wooden lattices, domed roof kiosk.

assets.name: SM_Desert_House_B
assets.notes: Stepped Rapan house: single-storey block with a roof terrace behind a stepped parapet, a setback upper room, an outside stair and a cloth awning on poles.

assets.name: SM_Desert_House_C
assets.notes: Domed Rapan house: sandstone cube with a large central dome on an octagonal drum and a flat-roofed side room.

assets.name: SM_Desert_Shop_A
assets.notes: Rapan shop: wide arched shop front with a counter under a red cloth awning, upper floor with lattice windows and a wooden balcony screen, flat roof with merlons.

assets.name: SM_Desert_Inn_A
assets.notes: Rapan inn built around an open courtyard: two storeys of rooms, a deep arched gateway with double doors on the front, courtyard windows and awnings, parapets with merlons and a corner dome.

assets.name: SM_Desert_Tower_A
assets.notes: Tapering sandstone watch tower with slit windows, a corbelled balcony and an open domed lantern.

assets.name: SM_Desert_CaravanYard_A
assets.notes: Walled caravan yard (~27 x 23 m): sandstone perimeter wall with rounded merlons, an open arched gate (5 m wide) in the -Y wall, corner towers with domes, lean-to stalls along the back wall, a water trough and hitching posts. The yard floor is left to the terrain.

assets.name: SM_Asura_Wall_12m
assets.notes: Asura city wall segment: 12.0 m along X (x = -6..+6), walkway at 8.0 m, outer face -Y, rect merlons in 12/n m cells. Chain end to end every 12 m; cover joints with SM_Asura_WallTower.

assets.name: SM_Asura_WallTower
assets.notes: Asura wall tower centred on a wall joint (origin = tower axis); covers wall ends meeting at any angle; walkway doors on the +/-X faces at 8.0 m.

assets.name: SM_Asura_Gate
assets.notes: Asura gatehouse replacing one 12 m wall segment: flanking towers centred at x = +/-6 (on the joints), open arched passage 5.0 m wide on the origin, raised portcullis.

assets.name: SM_Noble_Wall_12m
assets.notes: Noble city wall segment: 12.0 m along X (x = -6..+6), walkway at 10.0 m, outer face -Y, rect merlons in 12/n m cells. Chain end to end every 12 m; cover joints with SM_Noble_WallTower.

assets.name: SM_Noble_WallTower
assets.notes: Noble wall tower centred on a wall joint (origin = tower axis); covers wall ends meeting at any angle; walkway doors on the +/-X faces at 10.0 m.

assets.name: SM_Noble_Gate
assets.notes: Noble gatehouse replacing one 12 m wall segment: flanking towers centred at x = +/-6 (on the joints), open arched passage 5.0 m wide on the origin, raised portcullis.

assets.name: SM_North_Wall_12m

assets.name: SM_Prop_MarketStall_A
assets.notes: Market stall with a sloped red cloth roof and scalloped valance, crates and sacks; counter faces -Y.

assets.name: SM_Prop_MarketStall_B
assets.notes: Market stall with a gabled blue cloth roof on a ridge pole, barrels and baskets; counter faces -Y.

assets.name: SM_Prop_MarketStall_C
assets.notes: Market stall with a flat green-and-tan cloth canopy, side curtain, hanging goods and crates; counter faces -Y.

assets.name: SM_Prop_Crates_A
assets.notes: Stack of four wooden crates with timber corners and bands.

assets.name: SM_Prop_Barrels_A
assets.notes: Group of three iron-hooped barrels (two standing, one lying).

assets.name: SM_Prop_LampPost_A
assets.notes: Iron street lamp post (~3.9 m) with a caged glowing magic crystal lantern.

assets.name: SM_Prop_Signpost_A
assets.notes: Wooden crossroads signpost with three pointing boards and a small cap.

assets.name: SM_Prop_Fountain_A
assets.notes: Town fountain: octagonal stone basin (radius 3 m, rim 0.75 m) with a flat water surface (MT_Glass placeholder) 12 cm below the rim, central column, upper bowl with its own water and a finial.

assets.name: SM_Prop_Bench_A
assets.notes: Park bench, 1.8 m, wooden slats on stone legs; the seat faces -Y.

assets.name: SM_Prop_Statue_A
assets.notes: Statue of a cloaked hero with a raised sword on a stepped stone pedestal (~6 m); faces -Y.

assets.name: SM_Bridge_Stone_12m
assets.notes: Single-arch stone bridge 12 m long along X (x = -6..+6) with 5 m deck width; the deck ends at z = 0 on the banks, rises 0.6 m at mid-span; arch span 8 m, abutments reach z = -3.6 (river bed).

assets.name: SM_Bridge_Stone_24m
assets.notes: Three-arch stone bridge 24 m long along X (x = -12..+12), 5 m deck; deck ends at z = 0, rises 1.0 m at mid-span; spans 6.5 m on two piers.

assets.name: SM_Bridge_Wood_10m
assets.notes: Timber footbridge 10 m along X (x = -5..+5), 2.6 m wide plank deck at z = 0..0.25 (slight camber) on stringers and two trestle bents reaching z = -3.0, with rails.

assets.name: SM_Prop_Pier_10m
assets.notes: Wooden pier: 10 m plank deck (2.8 m wide) running from the shore end at y = +5 out to y = -5 over the water; deck top at z = 0 (bank level), piles down to z = -3.0, mooring bollards and a ladder at the end.

assets.name: SM_Prop_Boat_A
assets.notes: Wooden rowing / fishing boat 5.2 m long along Y (bow toward -Y) with two thwarts and oars; origin at the waterline centre, the hull reaches 0.42 m below it.

assets.name: SM_Landmark_SilverPalace
assets.notes: The Silver Palace of Ars: white-stone palace on a terrace with a grand stair (front, -Y), 82 m main block and two forward wings around a court of honour, four corner towers and a central tower with silver spires (~62 m), roofline turrets and a giant columned portico.

assets.name: SM_Landmark_RanoaUniversity
assets.notes: Ranoa University of Magic (Sharia): a 3-storey stone quadrangle (~146 x 116 m) around a courtyard, a gate tower with an open arched passage on the front (-Y), four corner towers with green copper domes, and the great domed hall (green dome, ~52 m) with a glowing crystal lantern; crystal clusters on the towers.

assets.name: SM_Landmark_MillisCathedral
assets.notes: Millis cathedral (~84 x 52 m): twin west towers with spires (~62 m) framing a rose window and a triple portal on the -Y front, buttressed nave with aisles, transept, crossing lantern, apse and flying buttresses; white stone, blue roofs.

assets.name: SM_Landmark_RoaKeep
assets.notes: Castle of Roa: crenellated curtain wall (~66 x 54 m) with four round corner towers (red conical roofs), a twin-towered gatehouse with an open 5 m passage on the -Y side, the great keep at the back and a red-roofed great hall inside the bailey.

assets.name: SM_Landmark_RikarisuHall
assets.notes: Rikarisu great hall / arena carved into a demon-rock outcrop (~64 x 52 m, ~24 m): a lumpy oval rock ring with stepped seating tiers around a sunken arena floor, a monumental carved portal on the -Y side with pillars, giant bone tusks and crystal braziers, and crystal clusters around the rim.

assets.name: SM_Landmark_RapanGuild
assets.notes: Rapan adventurer guild (~52 x 40 m): two-storey sandstone block with rounded merlons, a monumental pointed-arch portal (iwan) with the guild shield on the -Y front, two slender towers with domes, a great pointed dome on a windowed drum (~36 m), arcaded ground floor, awnings and banners.

assets.name: SM_Landmark_LabyrinthGate
assets.notes: Colossal labyrinth gate (~46 m wide, ~33 m tall) meant to be set into a cliff: the facade faces -Y and the block runs 14 m back (+Y) into the rock. A 13 x 22 m pointed opening is a dark 9 m deep recess with stepped archivolts; two 20 m guardian statues, a carved face with glowing crystal eyes above the arch, rune bands and a toothed frieze.
